purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer configuration, bounded anonymous requests, safe field limits, and uncertainty for Feni.
assessment: Bangladesh's official DLRS and Ministry of Land sources establish cadastral/mouza-map custody and public map-service context. The public map viewer's current JavaScript identifies a GeoServer route and wsDMMS:mouza layer, but the GIS host returned HTTP 503 for capabilities and a geometry/info request at the exact WUP point. The administrative lookup did not return Feni in the returned Chattogram-division district list, which may reflect incomplete project coverage or application data; it is not treated as citywide absence.
registryAssessment: Local/city service custody is evidenced at the official national/regional level: DLRS states that finalized mouza maps are held through settlement publication camps and district record rooms, and the official DLRS portal assigns Feni to the Noakhali zonal settlement office. No Feni-local public parcel-vector endpoint was qualified.
